notes.title: Whishlist Wobbly Construction! Now!
notes.content:
Whishlist Wobbly Construction! Now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2761990/Wobbly_Construction/

I'm thrilled to announce that the store page for Wobbly Construction! is now officially live! You can head over to the page and add it to your wishlist to stay updated on all the latest news and developments. It's been an exciting journey bringing this game to life, and I can't wait for you all to experience the challenging, wobbly adventure of climbing the tower. Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to wishlist the game to be notified when it's ready for release!
